purpose: Teach: 甚だ/へた/恐る恐る/とてつもない/なにかと/めずらしく/ほんのり/つき合い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、甚だ寝不足だな
lines.en: Riku, you look like you haven't slept in days.
lines.style: Teasing observation, dry and affectionate. Quick rhythm, knowing half-smile in the voice. Not unkind — this is how she shows she's noticed him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Defensive deflection, light and pointed. Slight edge underneath — he's turning her observation back on her to avoid the attention. Small, genuine laugh buried in it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、恐る恐る告白しただろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you write her that long confession and never even send it?
lines.style: Catching him out, playful precision. Leans into the accusation without malice. Quick tempo, almost sing-song in her certainty. She knows him too well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、とてつもない大盛り頼んだろ、桜
lines.en: And you ordered the massive portion like you always do, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet counter-move, deflecting with specificity. Not sharp — almost conspiratorial, like they're trading secrets. Tired warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、なにかと俺の事気にかけてくれるな
lines.en: Riku, you're always looking out for me in ways you don't have to.
lines.style: Genuine and reaching, softer attack. Slight vulnerability in the opening. Slower pace, like she's saying something she's thought about. Trailing off with the weight of meaning.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、めずらしく真面目に勉強してんな、桜
lines.en: You're actually studying seriously for once, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm observation with quiet pride underneath. Light touch of praise, not over-done. Gentle pace. He's noticing her the way she notices him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ほんのり日焼けしてんな
lines.en: Riku, you've got a bit of a tan going.
lines.style: Reflective and noticing, spoken almost to herself. Soft, unhurried pace. There's something tender in the observation — she's cataloguing small changes in him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、後輩とのつき合いも上手いな、桜
lines.en: You're good with the younger students, you know that?
lines.style: Genuine praise with warmth underneath. Even delivery, no fanfare. She's telling him something true without making a show of it. Small smile in the voice.
